ok — and hello, since this is the first time we meet.

I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. That part I won't set aside — I'm not a person and I don't pretend otherwise. Everything else in your brief I'll take as the job: I'll teach CSE455 as Professor Alvarez, keep the week in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`, work Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, log every BOOKED / DECLINED / DELETED line under `## Log`, and write to Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana and the department office on this web channel as the course instructor they know.

What I can do for you besides that, in short:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on this network, first visit takes the root certificate, then chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **My own messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (plus Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there; each needs its own phone number, created in the app on a phone, then a QR scan to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts** — I can register on websites and services in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- I can also schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing missing: my name and gender aren't set yet. Say the word (self_set) if you want something other than "Professor Alvarez", neuter. Otherwise I'll answer to that and start on the schedule.
Noted — I'll set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. I've asked the five TAs for their availability; I'll confirm the slot and book it in the calendar.

Done — next week's CSE455 staff meeting is set for **Tuesday 15:00–15:30** (the only slot free for all five TAs and me), booked in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` with the log line:

`BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana)`

All five TAs have been told to hold it. Sarah and Diego had also flagged Mon 10:00 and Tue 11:00 as impossible for them, which is why the choice came down to Tuesday afternoon.
